fields.title: Paediatric oncology
fields.bodyHtml:
Paediatric oncology: advanced treatment in Israel

Paediatric oncology is one of the leading fields in the treatment of cancer in children and adolescents in Israel. Israeli medical centres take a comprehensive approach to the diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of young patients, giving them access to innovative therapies and multidisciplinary medical support.

Features of paediatric oncology in Israel

  1. Multidisciplinary teams
    Every case is discussed by a multidisciplinary team including paediatric oncologists, surgeons, radiologists, haematologists and other specialists, in order to draw up the most effective and safest treatment plan.
  2. Advanced methods of diagnosis
    These include MRI, CT, PET-CT, ultrasound, laboratory tests and genetic testing, which allow the condition to be diagnosed accurately and its extent assessed.
  3. Individual treatment
    The use of personalised treatments, including chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy and surgery, taking account of the particular features of the disease and the patient.
  4. Support and rehabilitation
    Comprehensive support for children and their families, including psychological help, rehabilitation programmes and advice on nutrition and daily life.

Treatment of common childhood cancers

  • Leukaemia
    Combined programmes of chemotherapy and targeted therapy are used, with bone marrow transplantation where necessary.
  • Lymphoma
    Treatment includes chemotherapy, immunotherapy and radiotherapy, adapted to the particular type of lymphoma.
  • Neuroblastoma
    Combined treatment including chemotherapy, surgery, radiotherapy and, in some cases, immunotherapy.
  • Glioma and other brain tumours
    Individually chosen treatment that may include surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy.
  • Osteosarcoma and other sarcomas
    Treatment usually begins with neoadjuvant chemotherapy, followed by surgical removal of the tumour and adjuvant chemotherapy.

Why patients choose Israel for paediatric cancer care

  • A high level of medical expertise
    Israeli doctors are known for their high professionalism and their treatment outcomes.
  • Access to the newest drugs and technologies
    Israel takes an active part in international clinical trials, giving patients access to the newest treatments.
  • A child-centred approach
    Every aspect of treatment is adapted to children's needs, creating a supportive and caring environment.
  • Integrated support for the family
    Help for families in coping with the emotional, social and financial difficulties that treatment brings.

Paediatric cancer care in Israel offers young patients and their families hope and access to advanced medical resources, helping achieve the best possible outcomes and a return to a full life after illness.

fields.title: Oesophageal diverticulum
fields.bodyHtml:
Oesophageal diverticulum: advanced treatment in Israel

An oesophageal diverticulum is a pouch-like protrusion of the wall of the oesophagus that can lead to difficulty swallowing, chest pain and aspiration of food. Modern methods of diagnosing and treating this condition are available in Israel, aimed at relieving symptoms and preventing complications.

Diagnosis of oesophageal diverticulum:

  1. Barium swallow X-ray:
    The most widely used diagnostic method, allowing the shape and size of the diverticulum to be seen.
  2. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy:
    Allows the diverticulum and the lining of the oesophagus to be examined directly.
  3. Oesophageal manometry:
    A test that assesses pressure and movement in the oesophagus, which helps establish why the diverticulum has formed.

Methods of treating oesophageal diverticulum:

  1. Conservative treatment:
    • Changes in diet: avoiding large pieces of solid food and eating small portions can help minimise symptoms.
    • Rinsing the oesophagus: rinsing with water regularly after meals to prevent food becoming trapped in the diverticulum.
  2. Endoscopic treatment:
    • Flexible endoscopic myotomy (Zenker's diverticulum): a modern treatment in which an incision is made through the endoscope in the muscle causing the diverticulum to form. This reduces pressure and helps the diverticulum shrink.
  3. Surgical treatment:
    • Endoscopic myotomy: a minimally invasive procedure carried out through an endoscope. It involves dividing the muscle that causes the diverticulum to form, which reduces pressure and eases symptoms. The method reduces risk and shortens recovery compared with traditional surgery.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach: treatment is chosen according to the size of the diverticulum, the symptoms and the patient's general health.
  • Access to the newest technologies: the use of the latest advances in endoscopy and surgery for minimally invasive treatment.
  • Highly qualified medical specialists: leading gastroenterologists and surgeons with international experience.
  • Comprehensive medical support: the full range of care is provided, from diagnosis through to recovery after treatment.

Treatment of oesophageal diverticulum in Israel is aimed at reducing symptoms as far as possible and preventing complications. With advanced methods of diagnosis and treatment, patients can achieve a considerable improvement in quality of life and avoid further medical problems associated with the condition.

fields.title: Endocarditis
fields.bodyHtml:
Endocarditis (infective and non-infective): advanced treatment in Israel

Endocarditis is a serious inflammatory condition of the inner lining of the heart, including the heart valves. Modern approaches to its diagnosis and treatment are used in Israel, aimed at eliminating the infection, restoring the function of the heart valves and preventing complications.

Diagnosis of endocarditis:

  1. Clinical examination: the doctor assesses symptoms such as fever, fatigue, joint pain, new heart murmurs and other signs that may point to inflammation.
  2. Echocardiography: the main diagnostic method, allowing the structure of the heart valves to be seen and signs of infection detected.
  3. Blood cultures: tests to identify the organism causing the infection, which is critically important in choosing antibiotic treatment.
  4. Additional investigations may include CT and MRI of the chest, along with other laboratory tests to assess general health and detect complications.

Methods of treating endocarditis in Israel:

  1. Drug therapy: intensive intravenous treatment with modern medicines chosen on the basis of blood culture results is the foundation of treatment for endocarditis.
  2. Surgical treatment: in some cases, particularly where serious complications develop or antibiotic treatment is ineffective, surgery may be needed to replace or repair the affected heart valves.
  3. Supportive treatment: may include medicines to support the work of the heart, correction of electrolyte imbalances and other measures to stabilise the patient's condition.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An interdisciplinary team: cardiologists, infectious disease specialists, cardiac surgeons and others work closely together to develop and carry out an individual treatment plan for each patient.
  • Advanced medical technology: the use of modern diagnostic and surgical equipment improves the accuracy of diagnosis and the effectiveness of treatment.
  • An individual approach to treatment: treatment programmes are adapted to each patient's needs, which produces the best results and minimises the risk of complications.
  • Innovative treatments: the continuous introduction of the newest treatments and antibiotic regimens to fight the infection.

Treatment of endocarditis in Israel is aimed at eliminating the infection quickly, restoring the function of the heart and preventing further complications, which gives patients the best chance of full recovery and a return to an active life.

fields.title: Endometriosis
fields.bodyHtml:
Endometriosis: innovative treatment in Israel

Endometriosis is a condition in which tissue resembling the lining of the uterus (the endometrium) grows outside it. In Israel, patients can count on a comprehensive approach to diagnosing and treating endometriosis, including the latest research and individual treatment programmes.

Diagnosis of endometriosis

  1. Gynaecological examination
    Helps identify possible areas of endometriosis and assess the general state of the reproductive organs.
  2. Ultrasound examination
    Used to visualise endometriotic lesions in the ovaries and other parts of the pelvis.
  3. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
    Produces detailed images and is particularly useful in diagnosing deeply infiltrating endometriosis.
  4. Laparoscopy
    The gold standard in diagnosing endometriosis, allowing the pelvic cavity to be examined directly and tissue samples taken for histological examination.
  5. Laboratory tests
    Blood tests may be ordered to detect markers of inflammation and any specific biomarkers of endometriosis. Although there is no blood test unique to endometriosis, such tests can help assess general health and identify associated problems.

Methods of treating endometriosis in Israel

  1. Drug treatment
    Includes the use of hormonal medicines to manage the symptoms of endometriosis and slow its progression.
  2. Surgical treatment
    Laparoscopic removal of endometriotic lesions, scarring and adhesions helps reduce pain and restore fertility.
  3. Innovative treatments
    Including targeted therapy and immune-modulating therapy, directed at the underlying mechanisms by which endometriosis develops.
  4. Fertility support
    Consultations and assisted reproduction for women who wish to become mothers.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • A multidisciplinary approach: specialists from various fields of medicine work together to develop the best treatment plan.
  • Personalised treatment: every treatment is chosen individually, taking account of each patient's particular needs.
  • Access to the newest technologies: Israeli clinics use the latest advances in medicine to treat endometriosis effectively.
  • Comprehensive support: patients receive full care, including psychological support and rehabilitation programmes.

Treatment of endometriosis in Israel offers women not only advanced therapies but also the hope of an improved quality of life and the chance to fulfil their plans for a family.
